feedback.title: Share feedback
feedback.description: Tell us what you like about the product and what could be improved.

rating.label: How would you rate your experience with the product?

goal.label: How do you use the product?

options.startup: Use in a startup / small team
options.mediumTeam: Use in a medium-sized team (5–20 people)
options.largeTeam: Use in a large team / organization (20+ people)

liked.label: What did you like the most?
liked.placeholder: For example: intuitive interface and quick access to tasks

frustrating.label: What was confusing or frustrating?
frustrating.placeholder: For example: difficult to move tasks between columns

missingFeature.label: What feature would make the product more useful for you?
missingFeature.placeholder: For example: bulk editing of tasks

usability.label: How easy was the product to use?

extra.label: Anything else you'd like to share?
extra.placeholder: Any additional feedback or suggestions about the project?

feedback.success: Thank you! Your feedback helps us improve the product.

errors.goal: What is your goal of using the service?
errors.extra: You can add any additional comments

toast.title: Share your feedback about the product

bugReport.title: Report a bug
bugReport.description: If something is not working correctly, please tell us so we can fix it faster.

titleField.label: Bug title
titleField.placeholder: Example: Cannot move task between columns

expected.label: What should have happened?
expected.placeholder: Describe the expected result. For example: the task should move to another column.

actual.label: What actually happened?
actual.placeholder: Describe the actual result. For example: the task didn't move and an error appeared.

bugReport.success: Thank you! We'll look into the issue as soon as possible.

errors.location: Select a location or enter your own
